title: Dizon inspects NAIA ahead of Undas; flag delays in CCTV turnover
summary: Around 1.2 million passengers are expected at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) from Oct. 27 to Nov. 3 for Undas, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said on Friday.
